title: Country System
description: This is a country Plugin for all Server!
body:
# 🌍 Country Plugin – Show Player Countries in Minecraft!

Take your Minecraft server experience to the next level with Country Plugin! This powerful plugin automatically detects which country your players are from and displays this information wherever you want – in chat, on scoreboards, or in custom messages.
Key Features:

**🌐 Automatic Country Detection – reliably identifies every player’s location.**

**🏷️ Placeholder Integration – display countries, flags, or regions in scoreboards, chat formats, or other plugins.**

**🎨 Fully Customizable – adjust colors, symbols, and texts to perfectly match your server’s design.**

**⚡ Lightweight & High Performance – runs smoothly on Paper or Spigot without affecting server performance.**

**📊 Region-Based Stats & Info – create leaderboards or messages based on countries or continents.**

**✅ Easy Setup & Configuration – quickly installed and ready to use.**

With Country Plugin, you can:
Greet players in chat with their national flag or country🌟

Design dynamic scoreboards based on countries 🏆

Create country-based events or rewards 🎁

Perfect for servers with an international audience, community events, or just adding a “wow” factor for your players!


<details>
<summary>Placeholder</summary>

%countrypl%

</details>


<details>
<summary>Permission</summary>

countryplugin.admin

</details>


<details>
<summary>Commands</summary>

/country reload (Administrator)

</details>
